summary.en: Shanghai Pharmaceuticals combines distribution and established medicines with a focused innovative pipeline in immunology and neurological disease. Its late-stage assets include antibodies, a stroke small molecule and traditional Chinese medicines.
summary.zh: 上海医药将分销和成熟药品业务与聚焦免疫和神经系统疾病的创新管线相结合。其后期资产包括抗体、一款卒中小分子药物和中成药。

ind.zh: 强直性脊柱炎；另有斑块状银屑病

ind.en: Myasthenia gravis; also pemphigus and membranous nephropathy
ind.zh: 重症肌无力；另有天疱疮和膜性肾病

watch.en: BCD-085 is under review; the cervical-myelopathy program has reached pre-NDA discussions after Phase 3.
watch.zh: BCD-085正在审评中；颈椎脊髓病项目在III期后已进入NDA前沟通阶段。

watch.en: Nine-month distribution sales were RMB203.975 billion versus RMB18.989 billion pharmaceutical manufacturing sales.
watch.zh: 前九个月分销销售额为2039.75亿元人民币，药品制造销售额为189.89亿元人民币。

watch.en: Nine-month R&D spending was RMB1.516 billion, or 7.98% of pharmaceutical manufacturing revenue.
watch.zh: 前九个月研发支出为15.16亿元人民币，占药品制造收入的7.98%。

gaps: No standalone current pipeline webpage was located; the company pipeline presentation and current filings were reviewed.

Molecular targets for traditional medicines and SHPL-49, origins for several assets, and dated future events were not verified.
